messages:
maria: FYI — follow-up from the billing postmortem. We still have outstanding items around delayed usage ingestion and token count mismatches. Need owners and clear deadlines.

aj: I can take lead on the token reconciliation side. Plan to run a diff between the ingest pipeline and the billing ledger.

ryan: I’ll help with the SQL and queries to pull raw events. Suggest starting with a 7-day window around the spike.

aj: sounds good. initial plan: 1) run per-customer token diff 2) isolate accounts with >1% delta 3) produce adjustment CSV for ops.

olivia: I’ll prep the customer comms template for any invoice corrections — if we end up issuing credits, want a standard message and FAQ snippet.

samir: Ops can apply invoice adjustments if you hand over the CSV. Need to know whether we should auto-adjust or escalate each account.

maria: Decision: auto-adjust under $50, escalate otherwise. Add that to the runbook.

billing-bot: Automated ingest alert: delayed_event_queue length peaked at 104k at 2026-07-18T03:12:14Z (ID: dq-179). Logged to INC-612.

aj: quick note on recurring pattern — looks like delayed SQS batches correlate with a lambda retry storm. I’ll map retries -> duplicate token ingestion.

ryan: SQL draft (will run today):
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(ingested_tokens) AS ingested, SUM(billed_tokens) AS billed, SUM(ingested_tokens)-SUM(billed_tokens) AS delta
FROM tokens_events
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-07-11' AND '2026-07-18'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY ABS(delta) DESC
LIMIT 500;
```

aj: Perfect. After that I’ll join on message_ids to detect duplicates and tag root cause.

olivia: Proposed owner & timeline: aj — reconciliation CSV by 2026-07-22 EOD; ryan — query + verification by 2026-07-21; samir — adjustment run 2026-07-23; maria — comms sent 2026-07-24.

maria: I like that. Add checkpoints: 07/20 quick sync to share early findings.

samir: Question — for accounts with repeated small deltas across months (pattern), do we auto-apply cumulative credits or open a billing review?

aj: For recurring small deltas (<$10/month) we should accumulate quarterly and auto-credit. For anything sudden or >$50 handle per-incident. Add to policy.

olivia: Will draft a short FAQ: why credit was issued, how we computed it, how to dispute.

billing-bot: Note: manual invoice corrections require approvals from finance lead (olivia) and billing-auditor role.

maria: Action items recap (short):
- aj: full token diff + duplicate detection (due 2026-07-22)
- ryan: SQL & verification (due 2026-07-21)
- samir: run adjustments + post-run validation (due 2026-07-23)
- olivia: comms + approvals (comm template by 2026-07-21, approvals by 2026-07-23)
- maria: schedule 07/20 sync and own follow-through

aj: will post the reconciliation CSV to #secure-ops S3 with filename: reconcile_2026-07-22_{sha}.csv and ping when ready.

ryan: one more thing — I’ll add a small data quality alert to trigger if ingest/billing delta >2% for any 24h window. That should catch regressions earlier.

maria: great — can you add the alert to eng-oncall and finance?

ryan: yup. I’ll open a short runbook and cross-post.

olivia: Thanks team. I’ll prepare the customer-facing notes and a billing FAQ draft and share before the 07/21 checkpoint.

samir: Will prepare the adjustment playbook and include rollback steps + verification queries.

maria: Thanks — marking owners in the postmortem tracker. We’ll review at the 07/20 sync. :calendar: :thumbsup:

olivia: quick ask — should refunds show as separate line items or as negative usage rows? ops prefers negative usage rows to keep invoices shorter.

aj: negative usage rows are easier for downstream metrics. ops/finance please confirm in approvals.

billing-bot: Closure reminder: INC-612 -> set to in-progress. Next update due 2026-07-20 16:00 UTC.
